// REQ: LANG-1121 LANG-1122
package demo {
    import flash.display.Sprite;

    /* Block comment */
    public class Main extends Sprite {
        private static const MAX:int = 10;
        private var names:Vector.<String> = new Vector.<String>();

        public function Main() {
            var count:uint = 0x1F;
            var ratio:Number = 3.14;
            for each (var n:String in names) {
                trace("Hello, " + n + "!\n");
            }
            if (count > MAX && ratio != 0) greet(null);
        }

        override public function toString():String { return 'Main'; }
        internal function greet(target:Object):void { }
    }
}
